# Spark 2.3.1

Vendored from https://sparkjs.dev/releases/spark/2.3.1/spark.module.js .
Upstream: https://github.com/sparkjsdev/spark . MIT license in LICENSE.
Uses the existing Three.js 0.180.0 and its MIT-licensed postprocessing/Pass.js.
Spark decodes and renders true oriented, anisotropic Gaussian splats with its
embedded worker/WASM runtime. No CDN request is required during viewing.
